items.prompt:
Original broadleaf color-and-opacity atlas for a relightable game asset; separate complete leaves, consistent orientation, transparent gutters, neutral diffuse illumination, coherent botanical family, subtle age variation, intact tips and stems. No directional highlights, cast shadows, scenery, pots, labels, or lettering. Base color and alpha only.
Exactly 1024x1024 RGBA, exactly four separate botanical sprigs in a fixed 2x2 grid of 512x512 tiles. Do not rearrange this layout. TOP LEFT (tile 2): heart-leaf vine sprig. TOP RIGHT (tile 3): dense radial cluster of narrow lanceolate olive-like grey-green leaves. BOTTOM LEFT (tile 0): narrow lanceolate olive-like grey-green sprig. BOTTOM RIGHT (tile 1): broad glossy laurel-like sprig, but represented only by neutral diffuse base colour with no painted shine. Every sprig rises from the bottom centre of its own tile. Every complete stem and leaf stays inside its own tile with at least a 4-pixel transparent gutter on all four sides. All four root stems point down. True transparent background, fully transparent gutters; no checkerboard pixels. Photorealistic botanical surface detail, not vector art. No grid lines.
